purpose: Flexible multi-output app request templates that allow the mediator to synthesize and select among media, redacted media, semantic primitives, events, and aggregate outputs.

use_with_generate_pipelines_for_all_cont.note: The current generator mapping points at the old downstream_compatible filenames unless explicit request flags are used or TASK_TO_REQUEST_FILENAME is updated.

vocabulary_updates_recommended: Normalize semantic cap names between pipeline_vocabulary and operator_contracts: application/x-sound-event vs application/x-sound-event-label; application/x-occupancy vs application/x-occupancy-count/application/x-binary-occupancy; application/x-activity-event vs application/x-activity-label/application/x-safety-event.
Add explicit adapter metadata to app requests and generator matching: adapter_id, execution_mode, utility_validation_metric, and boundary_role.
Add OR-style accepted_ci_term_sets to ci_output_constraints so different output representations can require different informationType/transmissionPrinciple terms.
Move global residual caps out of app requests and into context-specific CI/risk selection, otherwise flexible contracts collapse back to one globally safest representation.
Add motion_feature/silhouette/fused_primitive caps and corresponding operators if you want more non-final alternatives for fall and ADL without exporting pixels.
